notes.subject: strongpela han
notes.rationale: וזרעו (zeroa, han) — sampla tanim tok i ridim olsem 'ol pikinini bilong em' (zera); KJV/ASV 'his arm' olsem mi, BSB 'its allies'.

notes.subject: Seol
notes.rationale: שאול i stap Seol — i no 'hel' o 'paia', i ples bilong ol man i dai daunbilo.

notes.subject: ol bilong strongpela han bilong em
notes.rationale: Pasin bilong tok Hibru: ol i stap wantaim long strongpela han — ol wantok ol i strongim em.

translation: Olgeta tu, wantaim ⟨את⟩ em, i go daun long Seol, klostu long ol man ol bainat i kilim i dai pinis; na ol bilong strongpela han bilong em i stap long sael bilong em, namel long ol lain bilong ol nesen.

tokens.gloss: ol man ol i kilim i dai pinis
